summary:
Positioned in the heart of East Sheen, this unfurnished two-bedroom second floor flat presents a fantastic opportunity to rent in a well-connected yet peaceful residential enclave. Boasting a smartly presented interior with a separate kitchen and a private balcony, the property offers a well-balanced layout with generously sized rooms and access to attractive communal gardens. Its convenient setting places you within easy reach of both nature and city life, ideal for professionals, couples or sharers seeking charm and practicality.

The reception room is a light-filled and versatile space with a neutral décor palette, soft carpet underfoot, and a large window that draws in the natural light. Its generous proportions comfortably accommodate a lounge, offering flexibility for everyday living.

Accessible from the living area, the private balcony is a welcome extension of the home, providing a sheltered outdoor retreat perfect for morning coffees or quiet evening moments. Overlooking the residential surroundings, it offers a pleasant outlook with a sense of privacy.

The separate kitchen is well-appointed with shaker-style white cabinetry, wood-effect worktops, and modern integrated appliances. A window above the sink enhances ventilation and natural light, while the layout makes good use of space for both storage and functionality.

The principal bedroom is a calming and spacious retreat, neutral tones, and a wide window framing treetop views.

The second bedroom is equally bright and welcoming. It's ideal as a guest room, child's bedroom or home office, offering versatility to suit a range of living needs.

The bathroom is stylishly finished in classic white tiling with a monochrome chequerboard floor, housing a full-sized bath with overhead shower, basin with vanity unit, and a frosted window for privacy and light.

There is free onsite parking (via permit through Richmond Council) and surrounding roads as also residents parking.

Residents benefit from access to the well-maintained communal gardens, offering a peaceful green setting just moments from the flat. Additionally, the sprawling Richmond Park - one of London's largest Royal Parks - is within easy reach, providing open green space, walking trails and deer spotting.

The property enjoys proximity to the independent shops, cafés and restaurants of East Sheen and Mortlake. A selection of supermarkets, gyms and schools are also nearby. For leisure, the River Thames is just a short stroll away, offering riverside walks and pubs. Kew Gardens and Barnes Village add further appeal to the area.

Transport connections are excellent, with Mortlake Station within walking distance, offering direct trains to London Waterloo. Numerous bus routes along the Upper Richmond Road and Clifford Avenue connect to Putney, Hammersmith and Richmond. Drivers will appreciate the close proximity to the A316, which links to the M3 and South Circular.

ADDITIONAL INFORMATION

The property is non-smoking. No pets.

TENANCY DEPOSIT: £2307
The tenancy deposit required for this property is equivalent to 5 weeks rent (6 weeks rent if the annual rent is over £50,000pa). If the rent is increased or decreased the tenancy deposit will be adjusted accordingly.

HOLDING DEPOSIT: £461
The holding deposit required for this property is equivalent to 1 weeks rent. If the rent is increased or decreased the holding deposit will be adjusted accordingly.

On successful completion of the pre-qualification form(s) a Holding Deposit will be requested in order to proceed with the tenancy referencing and credit checks. The value of the Holding Deposit will be equivalent to 1 weeks rent. On receipt of the Holding Deposit the property status will be changed to "Let - Subject to Contract/Let Agreed", no further viewings will be booked and the property secured. Should you be offered and you accept a tenancy with our Landlord, then your holding deposit will be credited to the first months rent due under that tenancy.

If the Landlord decides not to rent the Property or an agreement is not reached before the Deadline for Agreement (provided you are not at fault), we will refund the holding deposit to you in full.

If you provide false or misleading information which reasonably affects the Landlord's decision to let the Property to you, or if you fail a right to rent check, or if you withdraw from the proposed agreement, or if you fail to take all reasonable steps to enter an agreement when the Landlord has done so, we will retain your holding deposit. In the event that we intend to retain your holding deposit, we will set out in writing the reason for this within 7 days of either deciding not to enter the tenancy agreement or the Deadline for Agreement.
